m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What's that? The Hoarder has stolen a spell from Lydia Greyrose? I'm not surprised!
The Hoarder is one of Morganthe's servants, up to no good. It inhabits the ruins of the Plaza of Conquests, collecting magic!
If you wish to recover that spell, you must defeat the Hoarder and take it from the Hoarder's collection. I wish you luck!
Let me find that spell and I'll get you started...
Oh dear! I have terrible news! I've just remembered... my only copy of the spell has disappeared! It must have slipped my mind!
Now that I think about it, the spell vanished right at the time I received a visit from a strange figure wearing a hood.
You don't think it was... oh, my! I think the spell was taken by the Hoarder! Who's that, you ask? A servant of Morganthe!
We must recover that spell! Go at once to Dragonspyre, and speak to Milos Bookwyrm in the Atheneum.
You must recover the Woolly Mammoth spell from the Hoarder's clutches! Speak to Milos Bookwyrm in the Atheneum, in Dragonspyre!
